role: delegated independent paper architect/reviewer and source auditor
context: Full task context inherited; independent role, not zero-context
intended_claim_scope: Only the two predeclared scoped G0/G1 claims: reproducible model-feasible environment and finite-menu multistep effects; not learned-policy superiority

claims.claim: Environment maintains certified anchor/current/best, shared constraints, budget accounting, reward/output consistency and replay.
claims.basis: 43 regression tests passed in executor log; independent 7/7 extra runtime probes; 14,592 raw transitions audited; 32 selected sequence reexecutions by executor.
claims.limitations: Finite software evidence within supplied static model; atomic soft work budget, not all-input proof, hard deadline or physical IK guarantee.

claims.claim: Predeclared finite-menu depth-3 diagnosis can exhibit feasible deferred benefit after a worse first move.
claims.basis: 18/32 scenes have strict-worse-first final J below all queried root one-step J; 9/32 immediate-versus-descendant strict reversals; independent raw-ledger count recomputation.
claims.limitations: Existence within this development menu/depth. Only 2/32 beat all queried monotone-first branches; monotone-first is not all-steps-monotone. Does not prove deterioration necessary.

claims.claim: Trained budget-aware PPO stably improves on strong shared-action rules and generalizes across scene scales.
claims.basis: No PPO network training or model benchmark was performed.
claims.limitations: This is absent evidence, not a negative result that PPO cannot work.

what_results_support: An isolated non-monotone feasible-search environment with correct best/anchor output guard and reproducible action semantics under tested conditions.
Finite-menu deferred-quality effects in the fixed 32-scene development set.
Need to separate final J from reward after actual work penalties.
what_results_dont_support: Trained PPO advantage over Fixed3/Detour/fully tuned ALNS or BC.
Necessity of worse moves, cross-scale generalization, deployment speed, hard runtime/work deadline or physical arm IK.
Treating correlated tree transitions/leaves as independent scenes.
missing_evidence: Short-run PPO correctness: old/new logprob with exact sampled menu/mask, GAE terminal/truncation semantics and finite gradient diagnostics.
Matched-initialization BC versus PPO with same actions, repair, candidate caps and budget; strong tuned shared-action rule baselines.
Fresh held-out data, multiple training seeds, cross-scale evaluation and full planning time/work comparisons.
An explicit stable reward/work policy; post hoc reward audit cannot silently replace the preregistered quality metric.
suggested_claim_revision: Report G0/G1 as a validated research environment and finite development evidence of multistep effects. Keep learned-policy superiority as an untested research question.
next_experiments_needed: Before training, freeze reward/work accounting and STOP comparison, then audit rollout logprob and GAE.
Only a subsequent scoped G2: same BC start, short PPO budget, held-out development validation and shared-action rule controls.
Advance to longer/multiseed/cross-scale training only if short-run correctness and measured incremental value justify it.
routing_action: Confirm scoped G0/G1; supplement later with short-training evidence. No training or ablations launched in this stage.
writing_verdict: provisional — no paper claim audit available
supplementary_reward_scope: Post-registration descriptive analysis using fixed original lambda_work/work_scale and terminal menu charges. Does not replace preregistered J; scene-level counts, not independent leaf samples.
resolved_findings: rollout_record now rejects a different legal action than the one executed
artifact replay compares saved plan, reward components, policy trace/state
deadline after initial observation replays pending menu work; independently reproduced original failure and passed same saved artifact after fix
